waived.reason: USB-C SBU1/SBU2 on the ESP32-S3 service port are intentionally unconnected. This port carries USB 2.0 data and power for service and recovery only; no alternate mode, no debug accessory mode and no analogue audio accessory is supported on K1-CORE-VAL-R0, so SBU1/SBU2 have no defined function to route to.
